question: In which of the following states is the Losoong festival celebrated?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sikkim.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The Losoong Festival is one of the most prominent events in **Sikkim**__, a state in North East India.
 
• The Sikkimese New Year begins with Losoong, which is celebrated with tremendous enthusiasm and zeal throughout the province.
 
• The event takes place at the end of the **harvesting season,** providing much-needed joy and excitement for all of the farmers who have worked hard all year.
 
• Losoong festival was formerly restricted to the **Bhutia people**; however, it gradually extended to the Lepchas, and it is today celebrated by other minor tribes from **Sikkim, Darjeeling, and Nepal.**
 
• **Cham dances** performed by the Buddhist Monks are this festival’s main attraction.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **__Important Points__**

__
 
• Major festivals In **Sikkim** are:

 
 
• Saga Dawa
 
• Drupka Teshi
 
• Losoong
 
• Barahimzong
 
• Phang Lhabsol
 
• Kagyed Dance
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
